reason: The v1 runner excluded the entire benchmarks/ directory from git status. The runner, grid, constants, and checker could therefore be uncommitted while the manifest still reported a clean producer. The recorded commit does not contain the runner that selected the candidate.

existing_output.interpretation: Retained for review provenance only; not a frozen reproducible campaign artifact.

replacement_behavior: Exclude only the CSV, manifest, and scratch files generated by the runner.
Refuse execution when experiment-defining files are dirty.
Record SHA-256 hashes of the runner and evaluator source files.
Require a clean rerun from scratch rather than mixing rows from the invalidated campaign.
